name: rastchin-vscode
description: Improves Persian RTL readability in VS Code Markdown Preview, Claude Code, and Codex webviews.
author: Mo. MIKAELI / Omega Do IT Solutions

commands.title: RastChin for VS Code: Inspect Agent Patch Plan
RastChin for VS Code: Re-apply Patches
RastChin for VS Code: Disable / Restore Patches
RastChin for VS Code: Clean Legacy Extension Patches

persianRtlClean.patchOnStartup.description: Automatically re-apply Claude Code and Codex webview patches on VS Code startup. Default is false so installation does not modify other extensions until you opt in.

persianRtlClean.patchClaudeCode.description: Include Claude Code webview and Plan Preview when applying or restoring patches.

persianRtlClean.patchCodex.description: Include Codex / ChatGPT webview when applying or restoring patches.

persianRtlClean.patchClaudePlanPreview.description: Patch Claude Code Plan Preview when its embedded HTML layout passes RastChin compatibility checks. Disable this to limit Claude changes to webview/index.css and webview/index.js.

persianRtlClean.confirmBeforePatching.description: Show the read-only patch plan and require confirmation before a manual patch operation modifies installed agent extensions.

persianRtlClean.experimentalWorkbenchPat.description: Reserved opt-in flag for future VS Code workbench patching. This extension does not patch workbench.html or product.json by default.
